title: iOS app is too slow to load
body: I’d love to use it , I love the app, if it didn’t take sooo long to load! Feels like Apple holds competing apps back to favour its own, but they’re not the same.
author: MCC007!

title: Comments?
body: Really need the comments back on the tasks, was a key feature in Wunderlist and would be a miss IMO not to have them here
